rationale.conceptual: The task uses an established Tersoff potential with published parameters, applied to a classical ionic conductor. It requires standard MD skills (energy-volume curves, equation-of-state fitting, elastic constant calculation, MSD analysis). The method is not novel; a solver can use off-the-shelf MD codes like LAMMPS to implement the workflow without deep custom code.
rationale.execution: The reproduction pipeline has two main scored stages: (1) zinc-blende structural/elastic properties requiring several MD runs at different volumes and small-strain deformations, (2) rocksalt diffusion under multiple pressure-temperature conditions (at least 15 separate trajectories). This forms a multi-step workflow with looping, post-processing, and output assembly, fitting 4-6 interdependent stages.
